from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
                while st:
                    r,k=st.pop(); comp.append((r,k))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nk=r+dr,k+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nk<W and not seen[nr][nk] and g[nr][nk]==c:
                            seen[nr][nk]=True; st.append((nr,nk))
                rr=[p[0] for p in comp]; cc=[p[1] for p in comp]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rr),max(rr),min(cc),max(cc)
                if r1-r0+1==1 or c1-c0+1==1: continue
                # check solid rectangle
                ok=all(g[r][k]==c for r in range(r0,r1+1) for k in range(c0,c1+1))
                if not ok: continue
                hgt=wid=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
                fh=7 if hgt%2==1 else 2
                for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                    for k in range(c0,c1+1):
                        out[r][k]=fh
    return out
